answer_1.quote: We propose a method for generating structured explanations... using GPT-4o to extract factual triplets.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate generated triplets using BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L and BERTScore.

answer_3.quote: To ensure each generated claim was semantically contradictory... we filtered candidates using DeBERTa-Large-MNLI.

answer_4.quote: Manual evaluation of 50 chart-to-table conversions... assessed according to three criteria: fidelity... omission... hallucination.
answer_4.guideline: Assessing fidelity to original, omission of information, and hallucination
